tagline: Over a hundred ways to move between clips
summary: Fades, wipes, slides, zooms, page turns and many more transitions to join two clips smoothly. From simple cuts to dramatic effects such as a cube flip or water drop.
useCases: Add a quick slide or zoom to keep a fast pace
Use a dramatic transition for a big reveal
howTo: Place two clips next to each other on the timeline
Drag a transition onto the join between the clips
Change its length in the Inspector
